'''H0-M3''' was a [[Shopkeeper droid/Legends|vendor droid]] that served the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. He sold gear in the [[Republic outpost (Felucia)|Republic outpost]] on [[Felucia/Legends|Felucia]].

==Behind the scenes==
H0-M3 first appeared in [[Star Wars: Clone Wars Adventures (video game)|''Star Wars: Clone Wars Adventures'']] as a Felucian token vendor.
